sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- To use the GP-25, press the hotkey (Default 2 or 3) for the weapon it is attached to, while it is in your hands.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: "Kostyor", the project codename for the GP-25, translates to "Bonfire" in Russian.
